targetTexts.1: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
targetTexts.2: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
targetTexts.3: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
targetTexts.4: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
targetTexts.5: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
targetTexts.6: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
targetTexts.7: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.
targetTexts.8: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
targetTexts.9: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.
targetTexts.10: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.
targetTexts.11: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
targetTexts.12: Behold, these are the wicked—always carefree as they increase their wealth.
targetTexts.13: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
targetTexts.14: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
targetTexts.15: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
targetTexts.16: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight
targetTexts.17: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
targetTexts.18: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
targetTexts.19: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
targetTexts.20: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
targetTexts.21: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
targetTexts.22: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
targetTexts.23: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
targetTexts.24: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
targetTexts.25: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
targetTexts.26: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
targetTexts.27: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
targetTexts.28: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
